HLA_transcription_notes.RA957: Table S1 prints B*39.01; dot normalized to colon without changing the allele digits.
HLA_transcription_notes.CM647: Table S2/body also spell this cell line CM467; exact run names and Table S1 use CM647.
HLA_transcription_notes.all_samples: Measured genotype/candidate set, not experimentally measured peptide-specific restriction or allele-expression quantification.

peptide_normalization: strip and uppercase; canonical amino acids, exact length 9; retain original sequence
row_filter: exclude Reverse + and Potential contaminant +; retain original accepted identification flags, PEP and score; do not replace FDR with a PEP cutoff
modification_policy: base-sequence detection; peptide table aggregates modification states; no claim of unmodified chemical identity
repeat_policy: retain singletons separately; equal-condition units only; RA957 three preparation units each with two instrument injections plus three separate instrument diagnostics; reused CD165 1e8 search view retained but not additional replicate
